item.title: Nidozaki! Tartelette
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Shiratama
  • 発売日: 2009-06-26
  • スコア: 6.17/10 (12 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 2度咲き！タルトレット
  • 英語名: Nidozaki! Tartelette

别名

  • ２度绽放！十月樱

あらすじ

Akito has just returned to Japan after finishing patissier training and goes to a cake shop called October Cherry he frequently visited before. However, he is surprised to see the shop, “Oh, it can’t be true….” The shop is totally dilapidated. It seems the previous owner passed away and his daughters are now running the shop. But it doesn’t go well and the shop will be closed soon. Akito decides to work with the daughters to pull together October Cherry and save it from closing down..

别名

  • 虹色炼金橘子

あらすじ

Yudai is in his second year of a magic school, living in the school’s dorm. He enjoys his school life with his classmates, Touka, Ayane, Rinko and Hikari.

One day, Touka says to him that she will be able to make gold. “I’ll let you know when I make it!” But, she needs his semen to make it. After twists and turns, he finally gives her his semen. A while later, she makes a seed that will bear gold fruit. But, what the tree bears are some rainbow color oranges. Are they just oranges, or…?

item.title: Yokujou Pet Life!!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Shiratama
  • 発売日: 2006-10-27
  • スコア: 6.26/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 欲情ペットライフ!!
  • 英語名: Yokujou Pet Life!!

あらすじ

I go to Yuna’s house to wake her up every morning. I take off my shoes and go up the stairs to her room. “Yuna, are you awake?” No reply…. I knock on the door several times… but there is still no reply. I sigh and open the door…. There is a girl with blond hair sleeping on the bed. “Yuna, wake up, you’ll be late for school.” I shake her to wake her up. She suddenly opens her eyes and says, “Don’t shake me strong!”, and her heel kick hits me…. “Good… morning…, Yuna….” This is Masamune’s morning routine work….
